science_card_focus: Author exactly the source-contained matched pair in Supplementary Figure S5 at fixed m=1 and g^2=15: gauge-invariant initial state has time-averaged half-chain entropy S_GI(t)=0.386(6)t+0.43(2); superselection-sector initial state has S_SS(t)=2.94(2)log(t)+1.33(3). Use public time t only on the reviewer-transcribed conservative common interval [2,5]. N=8, PBC, hardcore-gluon model, half-chain definition, and averaging window Delta t=2.5 are common. The two initial-state constructions are private branch conditions. Preserve fit and uncertainty semantics; no other claims or domains.

issues.detail: Both the human quantitative_form and the source say S_SS=2.94 log(t)+1.33 at fixed g^2=15, but claim.control_names and oracle_outputs use g2 inside log. The executable card therefore answers a different scientific question. At g2=1,5,15 it returns 1.33, 6.0617474626, and 9.2916675912, values that correspond only to inserting t=1,5,15 into the time fit. Replace the public control with time t and make g^2=15 a source-anchored common fixed condition.

The source qualitatively reports approximately logarithmic-in-time SS growth across almost all g^2 curves in [0,15], but the numeric slope 2.94(2) and intercept 1.33(3) are explicitly the fit of the g^2=15 curve only. The current claim applicability and g2 control domain imply that one coefficient pair predicts entropy throughout the coupling interval, which the source never states. Preserve the broader coupling observation as provenance, but bind the executable coefficients only to fixed g^2=15.

Because the AST computes log(g2), the declared g2=0 boundary raises an undefined-expression error. After correcting the control to t, t=0 is likewise outside the logarithmic fit and cannot be used: the source separately states that the SS matrix-product initial state has bond dimension chi=4 and starts at entropy log_2(chi), whereas the fit would be singular. The TeX packet reports no fit-time endpoints or sampled time grid. Extend the source packet with the plotted/fitted positive time range before any deterministic point queries; do not invent bounds from the formula.

The card contains only one SS claim, so there are no disjoint source-contained branches and an eligible review cannot select a non-degenerate matched pair. The frozen supplement supplies the natural companion under the same m=1, g^2=15 and entropy protocol: S_GI(t)=0.386(6)t+0.43(2) versus S_SS(t)=2.94(2)log(t)+1.33(3). A new card should encode both relations, add GI and SS initial-state fixed conditions as mutually exclusive private conditions, and retain apparatus/model conditions as common.

The ScienceCard says it is unknown whether SS entropy is time-averaged. The supplement explicitly defines the time-averaged entropy with Delta t=2.5 and the Fig. S5 caption describes both GI and SS panels as time-averaged, while reporting both fits. Select this common statistic, add Delta t=2.5 as a common fixed condition, and remove the linked ambiguity only in a freshly reviewed card. Do not describe the Oracle as raw entropy if the selected fit comes from this averaged comparison.

All current fixed conditions belong to the SS claim and no GI condition exists. For the source-supported pair, N=8/PBC, m=1, g^2=15, the hardcore-gluon model, half-chain entropy definition, and Delta t=2.5 averaging are common; the equal superposition of superselection sectors and the gauge-invariant initial state are private alternatives. Encode this partition explicitly and ensure each claim cites only its own private condition plus every common condition.

previous_science_card.assessment: The source provides a quantitative study of disorder-free localization (DFL) in a non-Abelian SU(2) lattice gauge theory. The best quantitative cluster is the entanglement entropy scaling in the SS sector as a function of gauge coupling g^2 at fixed mass m=1, with a logarithmic fit S_SS = 2.94(2) log(t) + 1.33(3) at g^2=15. This provides a numeric control (g^2), a numeric readout (entanglement entropy), a quantitative mechanism (logarithmic growth), and an explicit domain (g^2 in [0,15]). The case is authoring-ready.

previous_science_card.paper_scope: The paper investigates dynamical phases of a (1+1)D truncated SU(2) lattice gauge theory with dynamical matter, focusing on disorder-free localization (DFL), Hilbert space fragmentation (HSF), and ergodic behavior. It uses exact diagonalization on an N=8 site chain with periodic boundary conditions, and studies matter imbalance, quark populations, and entanglement entropy scaling.
